revisions.change_explanation: Initial chapter actor: the precept master, his invitation, arrival, ordinations, title, temple, and death, with the chronicle's age variant preserved.

content.summary: 鑒眞, the Yangzhou precept master whom the envoys invited at 延光寺 in 天寶十二載 (753) and who sailed with the returning embassy, reaching 大宰府 in 753 and 東大寺 in 754. The biography records a precepts platform and imperial ordinations in the fourth month of 754, the title 大和上 and the founding of 唐招提寺 in the coda years, and his death in 寶字七年 (763) at 76; the chronicle's death notice gives 77.

names.note: Chinese reading recorded as an editorial aid; the Japanese reading Ganjin is not a separate name form.
Title granted by the court in 天平寶字二年 (758), recorded as an alternate form for search rather than a second person.

validity.source_expression: 天寶十二載十月十五日壬午 揚州延光寺; 寶字七年五月 物化

roles.note: The chapter documents his mission role from the 753 invitation to the 763 death notice.

external_ids.note: External identifier found in the Wave 1A feasibility pass.

content.editorial_notes: The biography is hagiographic and single-source for the ordinations; the chapter labels its claims accordingly and keeps the chronicle's independent title notice and age variant. He is recorded as a person; the temple he founded is a place record and the coda relationships point at it.

claims.statement: The chronicle names 鑒眞 as the Tang monk who returned with 古麻呂 in 天平勝寶六年正月 and later received the title 大和上.
